label: Diagram 15.1
caption: Diagram 15.1 Example of building footprint and perimeter | Buildings fitted with fire mains
description: Two views of a building are shown. The upper view is an isometric drawing of a white pitched‑roof building set between two grey blocks representing adjoining buildings; a green shaded strip lies along the lower part of the front wall near the right‑hand grey block, with a door shown. The lower view is a plan captioned "Plan of building AFGL where AL and FG are walls in common with other buildings." Its outline carries the letters A, B, C, D, E, F along the upper edge and L, K, J, I, H, G along the lower edge. Grey blocks flank the plan at the left (joining A to L) and right (joining F to G) sides. A green shaded area runs along the lower edge between H and G, with a door arc beside G. Dashed lines extend outward from the lower notch to the points N and M. Surrounding running text defines the footprint as ABCDEFGHMNKL and the perimeter as (A to B to C to D to E to F) plus (G to H to M to N to K to L), notes the green shaded area as one possible example of 15% of the perimeter, with a door in this length, and adds that if the building does not have walls in common with other buildings, the lengths AL and FG would be included in the perimeter.
